chapter_seo_title: The Treasure Competition: Ji Ning Wins the Peacock Tail for 5 Million Jin
chapter_meta_description: The Treasure Competition Assembly reaches a fever pitch. Ji Ning shocks everyone with a bid of five million jin of Primordial Liquid for the Five Elements Peacock Tail. But can he actually afford it? Tension peaks as Heavenly Treasures Mountain sends auditors.
og_title: Ji Ning Drops 5 Million Jin on a Single Feather!
og_description: The bidding war for the Peacock Tail reaches an insane climax. Watch our boy Ji Ning bankrupt the competition and secure a game-changing forging material.
twitter_title: Ji Ning goes all in at the auction!
twitter_description: Ji Ning shocks the high-rollers by bidding 5 million jin of Primordial Liquid for the Five Elements Peacock Tail. The crowd is stunned!

lore_anchors.definition: A monthly high-stakes auction hosted by Heavenly Treasures Mountain's headquarters where rare and unique treasures sometimes appear.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, used as high-value currency for large purchases among cultivators.

An Immortal-ranked low-grade magic treasure that contains 'Green Strand Divine Fire,' a powerful flame that can be used to attack enemies or help a cultivator raise their internal flame to the first grade.
A supreme forging material that contains the essence of the Five Elements, used to forge high-grade Immortal-ranked treasures.
